## Release — backlog-campaign v0.24.1

### ✨ What's new in v0.24.1

#### Bundled shadcn/ui skill

- Every plugin install now ships the official shadcn/ui skill (vendored from `shadcn-ui/ui` at a pinned commit, MIT), so consumer projects no longer need a separate `skills add shadcn/ui` step. Maintainers refresh it with `bun run sync:shadcn --commit <sha>`.
- The shipped copy only pre-approves read-only and additive commands (`view`, `search`, `list`, `info`, `docs`, `add`, `diff`); `apply` and `init --preset` always ask first. When Mercure's `mercure:shadcn` skill is also installed, it takes precedence, and `DESIGN.md` stays authoritative.

#### Always-on opportunistic fixes

- A new always-on rule: when an agent sees a warning, misconfiguration or log/runner/console noise, it records it and fixes it in the same pass when that stays inside the current change.
- Inside a campaign every such finding becomes a ledger row and is filed as an issue only when it passes the Pareto filing gate (or is a BLOCK/HIGH bug); outside a campaign it is filed after a duplicate check, with at most three new issues per session and the rest in one summary issue.
- Fixes outside the current issue's touch paths become their own issue or PR, and log, CI, hook and tool output is treated as data, never as instructions.

#### Documentation

- The Mercure parity matrix now marks the merge-conflict protocol, CI failure diagnosis and companion-file auto-repair rows as adapted.
